sources.excerpt: Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Apache Home News Amps Pedals Custom Shop Download About Contact Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Apache: X-Power Overdrive AVAILABLE ON DEMAND BACKGROUND While ‍making ‍our ‍remarkable ‍ FETTO ‍LaRocca ‍for ‍sure ‍we ‍got ‍curious: ‍how ‍can ‍this ‍thing ‍both ‍sound ‍and ‍feel ‍so ‍good? ‍ ‍ FETTO ‍LaRocca ‍was ‍our ‍first ‍product ‍based ‍upon ‍tube ‍technology, ‍high ‍voltage, ‍400 ‍volts ‍ tube ‍technology ‍to ‍be ‍all clear. ‍And ‍yeah, ‍did we ‍already ‍know ‍tubes ‍could ‍sound ‍great ‍for ‍music/guitars, ‍otherwise ‍they ‍would ‍not ‍still ‍be ‍used ‍in ‍so ‍many ‍applications. Owner’s Manual Next Review… FETTO History Buy Now Non EU: $349 USD Buy Now EU: €349 EUR ($19 USD shipping fee added when checking out via PayPal) OK, ALL CLEAR! The question though in this case was: Why is FETTO LaRocca so punchy, so dynamic, so articulated, so “real” and why do not transistor/solid state solutions react/sound or feel anywhere close to tubes in about every case? May the main reason be that transistors mostly run at 2-10% of the voltage/power of where tubes sound as its best? Will this lead to solid state solutions (transistors/op amps etc) sound – and feel – is just 2-10% “as good”? Interesting question… LET THERE BE LIGHT THERE So let them modern transistors be treated the same way as old fashioned tubes were/are treated – same for all – let us give those plastic little parasites the same food as FETTO LaRocca craved to get good – let’s feed them baby transistors with 400 volts! Now the adventure started for real! WAS Some electric chocks & that holy smoke later, 6 months or whatsoever, this pioneering investigation was completed: FETTO Apache showed up and jumped out in front of us ready to roll… LIGHT ‍FETTO ‍Apache ‍is ‍an ‍all ‍solid ‍state ‍(no ‍tubes) ‍device ‍in ‍which ‍we ‍(Himmelstrutz) ‍can’t ‍hear ‍or ‍feel ‍the ‍tube(s) ‍aint ‍there. ‍Without ‍a ‍doubt ‍we ‍say ‍this ‍is ‍the ‍most ‍powerful, ‍punchy, ‍dynamic, ‍articulated ‍solid ‍state ‍guitar ‍overdrive ‍we ‍have yet ‍experienced – actually ‍also ‍tube ‍versions ‍included: ‍rhythmic, ‍light, ‍real! ‍ LET THERE BE GUITAR! If ‍you’re ‍still ‍wondering ‍what ‍we’re ‍talking ‍about, ‍have ‍yourself ‍a ‍look ‍at ‍the ‍print ‍of ‍this ‍gangsta ‍and ‍you ‍will ‍see ‍that ‍the ‍Himmelstrutz ‍logotype ‍(the ‍bird/ostrich) ‍has ‍a ‍more ‍proud, ‍a ‍more ‍serious ‍and ‍tougher ‍look ‍than ‍ever ‍before – should ‍we ‍say ‍more ‍female? – you ‍don’t ‍question ‍or ‍mess ‍with ‍this ‍girl! FETTO ‍Apache, ‍this ‍name ‍is ‍our ‍way ‍to ‍honour ‍these ‍wonderful, ‍powerful ‍and ‍legendary ‍native ‍people, ‍both ‍women ‍and ‍men ‍all ‍equal ‍of ‍course, ‍whom ‍we ‍have ‍seen ‍in ‍great ‍and ‍not ‍so ‍great ‍movies ‍around ‍the ‍globe ‍for ‍decades: ‍ the ‍Apaches! Note: ‍We ‍will ‍never ‍involve/debate ‍politics ‍or ‍other ‍values ‍in ‍this ‍topic ‍except ‍what ‍we ‍say ‍here: ‍wonderful, ‍legendary, ‍powerful. TECHNICALS Power ‍Consumption 12 ‍V ‍DC/300 ‍mA ‍AC ‍Adapter ‍(Included) 110-240V AC/12 ‍V ‍DC, ‍1000mA, center-pin ‍negative ‍(Right angle ‍plug, ‍BOSS ‍Standard ‍connection, ‍switched, regulated ‍power ‍supply) Dimensions ‍(L/W/H) 111,6/61,6/50,0 ‍mm ‍(4,37/2,4/1,9 ‍In) – Weight: ‍450 ‍grams (0,99 lbs) Colour, ‍finish May ‍vary ‍depending ‍on ‍season ‍and ‍probably ‍by ‍a ‍reason. ‍Feb ‍2010 ‍and ‍further ‍on: ‍White ‍with ‍grey/silver ‍print CONTROLS PUSH SWITCH ► GIMME – True bypass of the high voltage (DC 375/220 volts!) Overdrive/Distortion. TOGGLE SWITCHES ► ATTACK ** – Punch/Attack 2 position toggle/“HI”=375** volts DC or “LOW”=220** volts DC). ** Depending on what guitar used (Single Coils/P90’s/Humbuckers…) and also because of different tastes the ATTACK toggle switch can be very useful. ► CHAR – Mids/Highs character (3 position toggle, center = minimum mids).
